changes.what: Growing cache per token (bytes; sliding-window and constant states excluded)

input.weights: 5 tensor groups added (178,526,208 parameters); none removed.

text: The model type changed from kimi_k3 to kimi_k31. Layer mix shifted from 69 KDA linear attention plus 24 MLA (full) to 69 KDA linear attention plus 24 Gated DSA on MLA, and the DSA top-k value is 2,048, having been not published for moonshotai/Kimi-K3. Total parameters increased from 2,779,931,837,184 to 2,780,110,363,392. Active parameters increased from 104,189,614,848 to 104,368,141,056. The growing cache per token, excluding sliding-window and constant states, increased in bytes from 27,648 to 33,792. Regarding weights, 5 tensor groups were added, totaling 178,526,208 parameters, with none removed.
